page.layout: One page of text: running head and title at top, page number top left; a woodcut engraving in the centre; verse below the engraving in italic lines; catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: [Woodcut engraving: soldiers with pikes before burning town; no printed text.]

l.i: Cum truculenta quatit sæuum Bellona flagellum,
Tot mala sunt bello, rutilo quot sydera cælo:
Flet victus, victor Marte cadente gemit.

page.notes: The woodcut shows two soldiers in the foreground, one with a pike, and a town in flames behind them. The title "NVLLA SALVS BELLO." and the running head "EMBLEMA" are set in capitals. The word "Inter" at the lower right is the catchword. Verse lines are set in italic with the long s rendered as a plain s.
